intro: An emotional, creative children's game where you color your own storybook and write your own tales.
description:
Crayon Story: Thumbelina is a creativity-boosting game based on the classic fairy tale that children love. Beyond just playing, children can decorate scenes and complete stories in their own words, fostering a sense of accomplishment.


Key Features


Coloring: Touch the screen to fill scenes with vibrant colors. With intuitive controls, anyone can easily create their own masterpiece.


Writing: Write your own sentences to match the colored scenes. Your child's imagination brings a unique version of 'Thumbelina' to life.


Personal Gallery: Completed pages are saved in your gallery, so you can revisit and enjoy your custom storybook anytime.


Start a fun artistic journey with Crayon Story: Thumbelina by GaniTani!
